title: 第141章 何必如此揣测为兄第141章 何必如此揣测为兄
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
“果然是感情淡了。”
沈栖尘走到两人面前，轻轻一蹭，就把云洛怀里的凌熠蹭走。
“我很早的时候就跟了阿洛，阿洛只罩凤弟，不罩我吗？”
云洛臂弯里突然就一重，沈栖尘潋滟的桃花眼含情脉脉。
“干什么呢！”
她一松手，沈栖尘往后倒了一小截，见她真不扶人，才像块木板一样站直了。
“嘁。”夜缙黎看不惯他这勾栏样式的模样，“装什么，你不欺负别人就算别人积德了，还罩你？”
“就是。”涂山鄞叉腰，“一万多岁的老东西了，也不害臊，你说是吧，龙弟？”
玄承老实点头：“是有些不害臊，不过沈兄你不必刻意这么说，因为阿洛一直都很罩着我们啊。就比如我，她帮我解开封印，还教我识字炼丹，我都想不到她不罩着我，我现在是不是还在那深渊里。”
“你给我闭嘴。”沈栖尘听着玄承的话就来气。
不就是跟云洛独处了几十年，至于动不动就提一次吗？
“我……”
玄承见他凶神恶煞，转身就躲到云洛身后。
沈栖尘想把他拎出来，玄承就躲，云洛夹在中间，跟玩儿老鹰捉小鸡似的。
“好了，别闹了。”
裴砚清看不下去，上前挡住沈栖尘。
他如今是天仙修为，虽然不是沈栖尘对手，但沈栖尘也不好强行把他拍飞。
“穷剑修，你在这儿装什么好人。”
沈栖尘瞪了眼玄承，又呛了句裴砚清。
装货，装什么大度清高呢。

他看就是想抢他嫡长夫的名头。
呵，他是不可能让的。
就算他最早认识云洛又如何，男人的地位，从来都不是先来后到，而是自己争取。
“沈弟，何必如此揣测为兄。”
裴砚清自然猜不到他已经在心里脑补了一出宫斗大戏。
“我只是觉得你们太闹腾了，阿洛布了十几天的阵，本就精神疲惫，需要安静休息。”
“你以为我就没想到吗？”
沈栖尘立刻软了嗓子跟云洛说话。
“阿洛，我给你换了新的泉水，泉水是我从金龙族的圣地借来的，全是从泉眼中取的最新鲜的，保证没人碰过。”
“另外，我也钻研了一套推拿之术，可以让你全身心享受泡温泉。”
说完，他得意挑了挑眉，目光蔑视地扫过在场每一个男人。
content_en:
"Sure enough, the feelings have faded."
Shen Qichen walked up to the two of them and gently nudged Ling Yi away from Yun Luo's arms.
"I followed A Luo a long time ago. A Luo only protects Brother Feng, but not me?"
There was a sudden weight in Yun Luo's arms, and Chen Qichen's peach blossom eyes were full of love.
"What are you doing!"
As soon as she let go, Shen Qichen fell back a little. Seeing that she really didn't help anyone, he stood up straight like a wooden board.
"Hey." Ye Jinli couldn't stand his hook-and-loop style, "Why are you pretending? If you don't bully others, even if they have good virtues, they still cover you?"
"That's right." Tu Shan Yin put his hands on his hips, "I'm over 10,000 years old, so I'm not ashamed. Don't you think so, Brother Long?"
Xuan Cheng nodded honestly: "I'm not ashamed, but Brother Shen, you don't have to say that because A Luo has always been protecting us. Just like me, she helped me unlock the seal and taught me how to read and make alchemy. I can't even imagine that I would still be in that abyss now if she didn't protect me."
"Shut up." Shen Qichen became angry after hearing Xuan Cheng's words.
Isn't it just that I have been alone with Yunluo for decades, and he mentions it every now and then?
"I..."
Seeing his fierce look, Xuan Cheng turned around and hid behind Yun Luo.
Shen Qichen wanted to take him out, but Xuancheng hid with Yunluo in the middle, like an eagle trying to catch a chicken.
"Okay, stop making trouble."
Pei Yanqing couldn't stand it anymore and stepped forward to block Shen Qichen.
He is now an immortal. Although he is no match for Shen Qichen, Shen Qichen cannot force him to fly away.
"Poor sword cultivator, why are you pretending to be a good person here?"
Chen Qichen glared at Xuancheng and choked Pei Yanqing.
Loading goods, what kind of magnanimity and aloofness are you loading?
It seems that he just wants to steal the title of his eldest husband.
Oh, there's no way he would let it go.
So what if he met Yun Luo first? A man's status is never first come, first served, but he must fight for it.
"Brother Shen, why should you make such assumptions about your brother?"
Naturally, Pei Yanqing could not guess that he had already imagined a palace fight drama in his mind.
"I just think you are too noisy. Aluob has been in battle for more than ten days. He is mentally exhausted and needs a quiet rest."
"You think I didn't think of it?"
Shen Qichen immediately softened his voice and spoke to Yun Luo.
"Aluo, I gave you a new spring water. I borrowed the spring water from the Holy Land of the Golden Dragon Clan. It is all the freshest from the spring. I guarantee that no one has touched it."
"In addition, I have also developed a massage technique that allows you to fully enjoy the hot spring bath."
After speaking, he raised his eyebrows proudly and glanced at every man present with contempt.
